answer: The ropewalk stretches long under the shed roof, and the hemp fibres hang in hanks from the beams. knoll combs the fibres straight and twists the first strand tight on the wheel. wharf walks backward down the walk, feeding the strand even as it spins. oasis tar-coats the finished rope and coils it in the loft to cure.
